params.name: period
params.description: Report period shortcut. Options: week, month, last_month, year.

params.name: after
params.description: Limit response to resources created after a given ISO8601 compliant date.

params.name: before
params.description: Limit response to resources created before a given ISO8601 compliant date.

items.docs: Returns aggregate sales data for a given date period. Includes totals for orders, items, discounts, shipping, refunds, taxes, and net sales. Supports period shortcuts (week, month, last_month, year) and custom date ranges.
